condition.keyFindings: A pronounced classic Madelung wrist configuration: smooth ulnar bowing of the distal radius and shortening of its ulnar side. The intact distal radial articular surface slopes steeply toward the ulna at about 40 degrees. The lunate migrates proximally into the V-shaped interval between the shortened distal radius and prominent distal ulna. The proximal carpal row forms a coherent triangular wedge. The scaphoid and lunate remain articulate with the radial surface and the capitate stays seated in the lunate concavity. The radius and ulna have smooth continuous cortical outlines and age-appropriate trabeculation.
